name: Bahama Bob's Beach Side Cafe
description: Bahama Bob's is a beachside restaurant in Gulf Shores, Alabama, offering fresh seafood, burgers, and classic beach fare. Known for generous portions, crispy fries, excellent service, and a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. A local favorite for lunch and dinner with a cozy, clean dining environment perfect for families and groups.
